title: Using Network360
body: Discover how Network360 works, from analyzing networks to identifying providers.

tiles.title: Accessibility
tiles.body: Accessibility is a powerful tool that allows you to determine whether networks provide sufficient access to members in a geographic area using standards detailed within a specification.

tiles.title: Compare Networks
tiles.body: Compare Networks is a powerful tool providing in-depth analysis of networks with overlap, volatility, network strength based on core providers, provider locations and offices.

tiles.title: Competitive Dashboard
tiles.body: Competitive Dashboard gives you an overview of competitive position with reports like Top Networks, Top Network Market Penetration, and Top Hospitals by Bed Count.

tiles.title: Create a List
tiles.body: Use this module to develop a list of providers that meet your selected criteria.

tiles.title: Disruption
tiles.body: Use this module to assess network competitiveness to another network using utilization data.

tiles.title: Look up a Provider
tiles.body: Look up a Provider enables you to find information about one or more providers that meet the search criteria.

tiles.title: Population File
tiles.body: A population file consists of a group of zip codes and employee counts that can be used as the geographic criteria for your analyses.

tiles.title: Provider Details
tiles.body: Read this article to understand the Provider Profile.

tiles.title: Radius Search
tiles.body: A radius search allows you to search for providers within the specified radius from the centroid of one or more zip codes.

tiles.title: Recruitment
tiles.body: Use this module to recruit providers that meet your selected criteria.

tiles.title: Tags
tiles.body: Read this article understand what Tags are and for details on adding, deleting, and using them.
